title: Jersey City algorithmic rent-fixing ban (Ord. 25-076)
requirement: No real estate lessor, agent or subcontractor may subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value for or use the services of a Service Provider, and no service provider may facilitate an agreement not to compete among lessors on rental pricing, fees or other rental terms.
coverage_conditions: Applies to real estate lessors, their agents and subcontractors, and service providers, in the residential rental housing market; no building age, size or owner limits are stated.
quoted_span: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for or otherwise utilize the services of a Service Provider.
